result:
I'd make humans significantly more curious and less tribal by default.

Most of the world's biggest problems—wars, bad policies, scientific stagnation, environmental mismanagement, even personal misery—aren't primarily caused by lack of resources or intelligence, but by people being more attached to their team, their comfort, and their existing beliefs than to actually understanding reality. If curiosity and truth-seeking were stronger instincts than tribal signaling or short-term emotional satisfaction, a huge amount of self-inflicted damage would just stop happening.

Everything else—poverty, disease, climate issues, AI risk, space exploration—becomes much more solvable when the species is collectively less interested in being right and more interested in finding out what's actually true.
